---
title: "🏃 Cram Sprint"
subtitle: "Time-budgeted study sequencer · pick a window, get a plan"
description: "How much time do you have right now? Click a button — get a tailored retrieval-driven sequence."
toc: false
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        .sprint-hero {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, #990000 0%, #5a0000 100%);
          color: white; padding: 1.8rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 14px;
          margin-bottom: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(153,0,0,0.18);
        }
        .sprint-hero h1 { color: white !important; margin: 0 0 .35rem; font-size: 1.7rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
        .sprint-hero p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
        .sprint-hero .accent-bar { height: 4px; width: 50px; background: #FFC72C; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
        .sprint-buttons {
          display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
          gap: .8rem; margin: 1.2rem 0 2rem;
        }
        .sprint-btn {
          border: 2px solid #990000; border-radius: 12px;
          background: var(--bs-body-bg); color: #990000;
          padding: 1.2rem .8rem; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem;
          cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
          transition: all .15s ease;
          display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; align-items: center;
        }
        .sprint-btn:hover { background: #990000; color: white; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(153,0,0,.22); }
        .sprint-btn.active { background: #990000; color: white; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(153,0,0,.3); }
        .sprint-btn.panic { border-color: #FFC72C; color: #8a6d00; background: rgba(255,199,44,0.15); }
        .sprint-btn.panic:hover, .sprint-btn.panic.active { background: #FFC72C; color: #1a1a1a; }
        .sprint-btn .num { font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; }
        .sprint-btn .lbl { font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
        .sequence { display: none; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; background: var(--bs-body-bg); }
        .sequence.show { display: block; }
        .sequence h3 { color: #990000; margin: 0 0 .8rem; font-size: 1.2rem; }
        .sequence ul { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 0; }
        .sequence li {
          padding: .55rem .7rem; margin: .35rem 0; border-radius: 8px;
          background: rgba(153,0,0,0.04); border-left: 3px solid #990000;
          display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .6rem; cursor: pointer;
        }
        .sequence li.done { opacity: .55; text-decoration: line-through; background: rgba(153,0,0,0.02); }
        .sequence li input[type=checkbox] { margin-top: .25rem; width: 18px; height: 18px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .sequence li .mins { display: inline-block; background: #FFC72C; color: #1a1a1a; font-weight: 700; font-size: .72rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; margin-right: .3rem; }
        .timer-bar {
          display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem;
          margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px dashed var(--bs-border-color);
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .timer-display {
          font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
          font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; color: #990000;
          min-width: 90px;
        }
        .timer-display.flash { animation: flash 0.6s ease 3; }
        @keyframes flash { 0%,100% { background: transparent; } 50% { background: #FFC72C; } }
        .timer-btn {
          border: 1px solid #990000; background: #990000; color: white;
          padding: .45rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-size: .9rem;
        }
        .timer-btn.stop { background: var(--bs-body-bg); color: #990000; }
        .panic-banner {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFC72C 0%, #f5a623 100%);
          color: #1a1a1a; padding: .7rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px;
          font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: .8rem; font-size: .92rem;
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
          .sprint-btn { padding: .9rem .5rem; }
          .sprint-btn .num { font-size: 1.3rem; }
        }
        </style>
---

```{=html}
<div class="sprint-hero">
  <div class="accent-bar"></div>
  <h1>🏃 Cram Sprint</h1>
  <p>How much time do you have right now? Pick a window. Get a retrieval-driven sequence. Tick boxes as you go. Your choice persists in this browser.</p>
</div>

<div class="sprint-buttons">
  <button class="sprint-btn" data-seq="s30"><span class="num">30</span><span class="lbl">minutes</span></button>
  <button class="sprint-btn" data-seq="s60"><span class="num">60</span><span class="lbl">minutes</span></button>
  <button class="sprint-btn" data-seq="s90"><span class="num">90</span><span class="lbl">minutes</span></button>
  <button class="sprint-btn panic" data-seq="panic"><span class="num">🚨</span><span class="lbl">Panic mode</span></button>
</div>

<div class="sequence" id="seq-s30">
  <h3>30-min sprint · pure retrieval, no new reading</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Scan IR 362 <a href="ir362/cram-sheet.html">cram sheet</a> — three throughlines + dates table only</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>15 flashcards mixed deck (<a href="flashcards.html">flashcards</a>) — flip, mark, no peeking</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>1 trap-drill problem from <a href="acct410x/trap-drills.html">ACCT trap drills</a> — work it, then check key</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Re-read 3 Marketing positioning bullets (<a href="marketing/index.html">marketing page</a>)</span></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="timer-bar">
    <span class="timer-display" data-target="30">30:00</span>
    <button class="timer-btn">Start timer</button>
    <button class="timer-btn stop">Stop</button>
    <span style="font-size:.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color);">Visual flash every 5 min</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sequence" id="seq-s60">
  <h3>60-min sprint · retrieval + 1 application rep</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Scan IR 362 cram sheet — three throughlines + dates</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>15 flashcards mixed deck</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>1 ACCT trap-drill problem</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Re-read 3 Marketing positioning bullets</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">25 min</span>Pick ONE: outline a <a href="ir362/mock-essays.html">mock essay</a> (thesis + 3 moves + Hammad frame) OR drill 5 ACCT trap problems</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Re-read the 6 trap-avoidance reminders on the IR 362 cram sheet</span></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="timer-bar">
    <span class="timer-display" data-target="60">60:00</span>
    <button class="timer-btn">Start timer</button>
    <button class="timer-btn stop">Stop</button>
    <span style="font-size:.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color);">Visual flash every 5 min</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="sequence" id="seq-s90">
  <h3>90-min sprint · full mock section + retrieval</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Scan IR 362 cram sheet — three throughlines + dates</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>15 flashcards mixed deck</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>1 ACCT trap-drill problem</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Re-read 3 Marketing positioning bullets</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">25 min</span>Outline a mock essay OR drill 5 ACCT trap problems</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">30 min</span>1 timed mock-exam section: <a href="ir362/mock-essays.html">IR 362 mock essay</a> (write the intro + first body para under timer) OR <a href="acct410x/mock-final.html">ACCT mock</a> Section A</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">5 min</span>Self-review against sample answer · note 1 fix for next time</span></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="timer-bar">
    <span class="timer-display" data-target="90">90:00</span>
    <button class="timer-btn">Start timer</button>

    <span style="font-size:.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color);">Visual flash every 5 min</span>

</div>

<div class="sequence" id="seq-panic">
  <div class="panic-banner">🚨 Panic mode · 4 high-impact retrieval tasks. The point isn't to learn new material — it's to feel competent, fast.</div>
  <h3>"I have an hour but I'm panicking"</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>Memorize 5 dates cold from the IR 362 dates table — say each one out loud + significance</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">15 min</span>Recite 3 essay-bank thesis statements aloud (pick from the <a href="ir362/cram-sheet.html#five-essay-bank-thesis-statements-deploy-adapt">5 on the cram sheet</a>) — say each twice without looking</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">25 min</span>Do 2 indirect-cash-flow problems from <a href="acct410x/trap-drills.html">ACCT trap drills</a> · the asset-up = subtract / liab-up = add direction rules are the highest-yield trap</span></li>
    <li><input type="checkbox"><span><span class="mins">10 min</span>Re-read the 6 IR 362 trap-avoidance reminders. Breathe. You know more than you think.</span></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="timer-bar">
    <span class="timer-display" data-target="60">60:00</span>
    <button class="timer-btn">Start timer</button>
    <button class="timer-btn stop">Stop</button>
    <span style="font-size:.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color);">Visual flash every 5 min</span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const KEY = 'studyhub_cram_sprint_v1';
  const CHECKS_KEY = 'studyhub_cram_sprint_checks_v1';

  function showSeq(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.sequence').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('show'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.sprint-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const seq = document.getElementById('seq-' + id);
    const btn = document.querySelector('.sprint-btn[data-seq="' + id + '"]');
    if (seq) seq.classList.add('show');
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, id);
  }

  function loadChecks(){ try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CHECKS_KEY)||'{}'); } catch(e){ return {}; } }
  function saveChecks(s){ localStorage.setItem(CHECKS_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }

  document.querySelectorAll('.sprint-btn').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => showSeq(b.dataset.seq));
  });

  // restore last choice
  const last = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
  if (last) showSeq(last);

  // checkbox state
  document.querySelectorAll('.sequence').forEach(seq => {
    const seqId = seq.id;
    seq.querySelectorAll('li').forEach((li, idx) => {
      const key = seqId + ':' + idx;
      const checks = loadChecks();
      const cb = li.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]');
      if (checks[key]) { cb.checked = true; li.classList.add('done'); }
      cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const c = loadChecks();
        c[key] = cb.checked;
        saveChecks(c);
        li.classList.toggle('done', cb.checked);
      });
      li.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'A' || e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
        cb.checked = !cb.checked;
        cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
      });
    });

    // timer
    const display = seq.querySelector('.timer-display');
    const startBtn = seq.querySelector('.timer-btn:not(.stop)');
    const stopBtn = seq.querySelector('.timer-btn.stop');
    let intervalId = null;
    let remaining = 0;
    function fmt(s){ const m = Math.floor(s/60); const ss = s%60; return (m<10?'0':'')+m+':'+(ss<10?'0':'')+ss; }
    function tick(){
      remaining--;
      display.textContent = fmt(remaining);
      // flash every 5 min boundary (when remaining is multiple of 300 and > 0)
      const target = parseInt(display.dataset.target,10) * 60;
      const elapsed = target - remaining;
      if (elapsed > 0 && elapsed % 300 === 0 && remaining > 0) {
        display.classList.add('flash');
        setTimeout(() => display.classList.remove('flash'), 1800);
        try { const beep = new AudioContext(); const o = beep.createOscillator(); const g = beep.createGain(); o.connect(g); g.connect(beep.destination); o.frequency.value = 880; g.gain.value = 0.1; o.start(); setTimeout(() => { o.stop(); beep.close(); }, 200); } catch(e){}
      }
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(intervalId); intervalId = null;
        display.classList.add('flash');
        display.textContent = 'DONE';
      }
    }
    startBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (intervalId) return;
      const target = parseInt(display.dataset.target,10);
      remaining = target * 60;
      display.textContent = fmt(remaining);
      intervalId = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    });
    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (intervalId) { clearInterval(intervalId); intervalId = null; }
      const target = parseInt(display.dataset.target,10);
      display.textContent = fmt(target * 60);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
